Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

bravo interjection

also splendid!, brilliant!, well said!, very clever!, terrific!, absolutely splendid!

classical

Plaut. Mil. 241b
Ter. Ad. 911
Traupman 99: euge, euge!
Traupman 108
Traupman 60

Euge!

Other words

  • Sophōs! — bravo! well said!

    also used · classical · Mart. 3.46.8; Petr. 40.1 (Lewis & Short s.v. sophōs); Traupman 94

    Greek σοφῶς; not before Augustus. Lewis & Short: Cicero says instead bene!

  • Facētē dictum! — well said! nicely put!

    also used · classical · Plaut. Capt. 1.2.73; Ter. Eun. 2.2.57 (Lewis & Short s.v. facētus); Traupman 292; Traupman 95, 405

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.)

Examples

  • Euge, euge!

    Bravo!Plaut. Mil. 241b

  • «Sophōs!» ūniversī clāmāmus

    “Bravo!” we all shoutPetr. 40.1

  • Facētē, lepidē, lautē; nihil suprā.

    Brilliant, charming, elegant; nothing could beat it.Ter. Eun. 427

  • Nimis factum bene!

    Absolutely splendid!Traupman 383

See also I did it, hit the target.
